title: Qaleela tasgayyeh tan gad
intro: Atu Yallih assakat le taama abeynah aydaadu baxxaqissam faxxa. Farmoytit kee miraaciini baaxoh addal, tama muuci qibaadah kitaabaay, caylale xongoloo kee birtak amol maqar luk barkat luk suge. Atu rortitte elle takriye innal, tah miyya kinnim baxissam duuddaa?
clues: Anu Yallih taama abeynak suge baxsale kitab yomcowwe.
Anu qaxmeqe xongolo luk sugeeh, yi faatit kaxxam kiciyyoh sugeeh, koomal kee kimmir yoot yengele.
Aytigexxole qeebih addat gibdi sadu yoo garayeeh, qunxuk sugaamal ayseh.
Birti yoh bicseeniih, inni gabat armor bicsam yoh xiqsiise.
Anu kaxxa agattiinah amoytah abeeh, yi cokmi cokmih wale aytî gexxo luk suge.
Yi baxi, kaadu nabiyyi, caacay kee jinni lowsiisih idini geeh.
arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
